migration.description: Remove the SQLite Analytics Journal fact_json storage length check through an atomic forward migration while preserving complete source rows.
migration.release_unit_description: C18 Analytics Journal complete inline payload storage migration

durable_state.description: analytics_change_events rows, source envelope metadata, event identity, state/coverage/snapshot/pin references, and the SQLite AUTOINCREMENT high-water mark.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite analytics_change_events with an independent analytics_change_journal_migrations marker and WAL-compatible create-copy-drop-rename migration.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Baseline dd6f108cc2796238c3c5dc4d7dad122a9df63275 and earlier supported Journal schemas consisting of the 12-column base table plus any subset of the declared compatibility columns.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: The candidate program containing C18 and the same-Major forward-repair releases that retain this marker and canonical schema contract.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Read-only preflight recognizes the supported source shape, then one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction creates the independent marker table and canonical temporary Journal table, drops the old table, renames the canonical table, and recreates the declared indexes.

dml_changes.description: Copy every supported Journal column in change_id order without JSON parsing or payload normalization, restore the maximum of the source sequence and copied maximum ID, and record the source manifest in the marker.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: Not applicable: this is a storage-preserving copy only; there is no historical fact semantic backfill or transformation.

progress_signals: Preflight errors identify an unsupported column, constraint, index, trigger, foreign key, marker, or leftover rebuild table before compatibility ALTER statements.
The committed marker exposes source and target fingerprints, source sequence, row count, maximum change ID, and manifest digest.
Re-entry observes the marker and canonical schema; WAL restart verification observes the same marker count, payload bytes, and journal mode.
pause_points: Before BEGIN IMMEDIATE, the operator may stop without changing the Journal.
Inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE there is no application pause point; rollback leaves the source table and marker uncommitted.
After marker commit, retry is an idempotent observation and does not rebuild the table.

recovery.evidence_policy: Do not delete an unknown schema, leftover rebuild table, or mismatched marker automatically; preserve it for operator inspection and repair.

patch.evidence_scope: Local candidate validation covers pure SQLite state fixtures and a real file/WAL restart fixture; test values are not production capacity or timing budgets.
required_test_evidence: Supported 12-column and compatibility-column source states upgrade without changing row IDs, event kind, source envelope, payload text, or payload bytes.
Canonical schema retains event-kind constraints and all declared indexes; state, coverage, snapshot, pin, and sqlite_sequence high-water state remain usable.
Unknown schemas and leftover interrupted rebuild state fail closed without blind rewriting.
A real WAL file survives close/reopen and recognizes the committed marker and canonical schema idempotently.
Payloads above 64 KiB and above 1 MiB are stored and read back without truncation.
